# AppLovin (APP) Research Brief
*Data as of 1 Oct 2026, 03:58 UTC.*

## Bottom line
AppLovin shares trade near the 52-week low following a significant negative move today, even as the company maintains strong year-over-year revenue growth. Recent media coverage reflects a bearish tone as analysts question recent installation spikes and potential headwinds for the stock.

## Key figures

| Figure | Value |
|---|---|
| Price | $290.43 |
| Today's move | -4.98% |

## What's in the news

- AppLovin shares reached a new 52-week low after commentary questioned whether recent installation metrics represented a sustainable trend ([APP Stock Hits Fresh 52-Week Low After Wells Fargo Calls Pixel Install Spike ‘A False Start’](https://finnhub.io/api/news?id=983adae6b74660c4619cfa7a9b467e93a742227ad67360bfb2000cde570962a7) - Yahoo, 2026-09-30)

# Jabil (JBL) Research Brief
*Data as of 1 Oct 2026, 03:58 UTC.*

## Bottom line
Jabil is experiencing a sharp downward move despite reporting positive year-over-year revenue growth and highlighting strong artificial intelligence demand. Recent media coverage reflects a bearish tone as shares face their worst performance in over a year following its recent earnings updates.

## Key figures

| Figure | Value |
|---|---|
| Price | $286.86 |
| Today's move | -10.03% |
| 52-week range | $189.60 - $428.93 (41% of the way from the 52-week low to the high) |
| Market cap | $30.46B |
| P/E (trailing 12 months) | 35.34 |
| Revenue growth (year over year) | +17.8% |

## What's in the news
The tone of recent media coverage is bearish.
- Jabil shares faced a significant decline despite providing details on the factors behind the drop ([Why Jabil (JBL) Shares Are Falling Today](https://finnhub.io/api/news?id=b8489dcee09e4abb0bbe6bb1155f436962294755695f4be70ff891e2d492a466) - Yahoo, 2026-09-30)
- The company experienced a notable share price decrease even while issuing a major outlook highlighting accelerating demand for artificial intelligence ([Jabil Sinks 10% Even as $44.5 Billion Outlook Flags “Accelerating AI Demand”](https://finnhub.io/api/news?id=fa0c244fb58e5e7421fb15dbb1f154e6648d36c350b3b5d1d1ceeda08e6032af) - Yahoo, 2026-09-30)
- The stock encountered its worst single-day performance in over a year as markets reacted unfavorably despite an otherwise robust outlook for artificial intelligence demand ([Jabil Stock Faces Its Worst Day in Over a Year. A Blistering AI Demand Outlook Isn’t Enough.](https://finnhub.io/api/news?id=a0404a93e41acaaa5f744754abebde2f154b21aff44beff25e19a28d07ccbaa7) - Yahoo, 2026-09-30)
- Continuous downward pressure on the stock demonstrated that strong long-term artificial intelligence projections were insufficient to prevent a sell-off ([Jabil Stock Is Falling. A Blistering AI Demand Outlook Isn’t Enough.](https://finnhub.io/api/news?id=5187c407e4fc91c4eafad0dee4e0966770311a797b6a75ebfbd7efcf7cf1350a) - Yahoo, 2026-09-30)

## Things to watch
- The market's negative reaction to Jabil despite a large multi-billion dollar outlook and positive revenue growth raises questions about how investors are weighing near-term expectations against long-term artificial intelligence opportunities.
- With the share price sitting closer to the bottom of its 52-week range following a sharp double-digit drop, market participants are monitoring whether current valuation levels accurately reflect the company's growth trajectory.

- Price and fundamentals: Finnhub (quote and company metrics), as of 1 Oct 2026, 03:58 UTC.
- News: the linked articles above, from Finnhub company news (last 7 days).

# Synopsys (SNPS) Research Brief
*Data as of 1 Oct 2026, 03:58 UTC.*

## Bottom line
Synopsys shares experienced a notable upward movement alongside a series of major strategic announcements, including high-profile partnerships and a raised long-term financial outlook. Recent media coverage reflects a bullish tone driven by major enterprise deals and artificial intelligence collaborations.

## Key figures

| Figure | Value |
|---|---|
| Price | $434.94 |
| Today's move | +4.78% |
| 52-week range | $362.55 - $539.48 (41% of the way from the 52-week low to the high) |
| Market cap | $80.37B |
| P/E (trailing 12 months) | 74.66 |
| Revenue growth (year over year) | +46.3% |

## What's in the news
The tone of recent media coverage is bullish.
- Synopsys shares climbed nearly five percent in a single session following a flurry of major corporate updates ([Why Synopsys Stock Soared Nearly 5% Higher Today](https://finnhub.io/api/news?id=1b2bd181aec3441518397bd1259c3041b6cbdc56fb2a4d6b3dc4ae8db09b6cc6) - Yahoo, 2026-09-30)
- Management raised the long-term 2030 growth targets during the Investor Day presentation, highlighting artificial intelligence, intellectual property, and Ansys synergies ([Synopsys Investor Day Lifts 2030 Growth Outlook on AI, IP and Ansys Synergies](https://finnhub.io/api/news?id=20690f20a4634c8f7f77fded8dd794d3fb721b0890a633971c945524d80f3518) - Yahoo, 2026-09-30)
- Amazon committed to a multi-year deal valued at over one billion dollars to utilize Synopsys silicon intellectual property and artificial intelligence software for custom infrastructure ([Amazon Signs $1 Billion Synopsys Deal as AWS Steps Up Nvidia Challenge](https://finnhub.io/api/news?id=98bc0a52eeb599fc711e05cc7b31651f9a3970ff70c074b60b97a21f99caaac1) - Yahoo, 2026-09-30)
- A new collaboration with OpenAI was unveiled to introduce GPT-Synopsys, aiming to integrate frontier intelligence into chip design workflows ([OpenAI and Synopsys Announce GPT-Synopsys: Frontier Intelligence to Revolutionize Chip Design](https://finnhub.io/api/news?id=4d049ddbafdd6a05ab46653a6e128829bdcad62139646260ebe5832f9f998375) - Yahoo, 2026-09-30)

## Things to watch
- The trailing P/E ratio sits at 74.66, which invites consideration regarding how much of the newly announced multi-year artificial intelligence and enterprise growth is already priced into the shares.
- The realization of long-term targets out to 2030 will depend heavily on the successful integration of Ansys synergies and the execution of massive contracts like the billion-dollar Amazon agreement.

- Price and fundamentals: Finnhub (quote and company metrics), as of 1 Oct 2026, 03:58 UTC.
- News: the linked articles above, from Finnhub company news (last 7 days).
